description: The disjunction of the terms selecting the true rows represents every finite truth function and uses only its listed inputs.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.canonicalDnf_represents.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] {n : ℕ}
  (p : Fin n → α) (f : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.TruthFunction n) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Represents p f
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.dnfFormula
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.canonicalDnf p f))
